name: dumbbell one arm seated neutral wrist curl
description: Sit with your forearm supported and curl a dumbbell with your wrist in a neutral position. It strengthens the forearms and builds grip.
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest one forearm on your thigh, hand just past your knee.
Hold a dumbbell with a neutral grip, thumb on top.
Keep your forearm still and tilt the dumbbell up by bending at the wrist.
Lower it slowly as far as is comfortable.
Finish the reps, then switch hands.
